TWITCHCHAT.SettingChannelHint: The channel name to follow, without URL and without #. Example: simonepenza
TWITCHCHAT.SettingEnabledHint: Enable or disable the bridge to Twitch chat. Only the active GM connects.
TWITCHCHAT.SettingIgnoredHint: Comma-separated list of usernames whose messages will not be shown (usually bots).
TWITCHCHAT.SettingIgnoreCommandsHint: Discard messages starting with ! (typically bot commands).
TWITCHCHAT.SettingEmotesHint: Replace Twitch emotes with their images.
TWITCHCHAT.SettingRateLimitHint: Maximum number of Twitch messages posted to chat each minute. Extra messages are dropped so the game chat stays readable. 0 = no limit.
TWITCHCHAT.SettingMaxLengthHint: Messages longer than this get truncated.
TWITCHCHAT.NoChannel: No Twitch channel configured. Set one in the module settings.
TWITCHCHAT.GMOnly: Only the GM can control the Twitch connection.
